title: Skyroot rockets to Unicorn status with $60 million fundraise; Trilegal, TT&A, CAM advise
description: Skyroot Aerospace Private Limited has raised $60 million from a fundraise co-led by Sherpalo Ventures and GIC, with participation from funds manage by BlackRock, founders of Greenko Group, Arkam Ventures, Playbook Partners and the Shanghvi Family Office.Trilegal advised Skyroot on this fundraise.The transaction team was led by Vishruta Kaul (Partner) and consisted of Bhavya Vatsa (Counsel), Advaye Sawhny (Senior Associate) and Saksham Gadia (Associate).Vishruta KaulTT&A advised investor Play
